module: Lightweight facade of the vehicle's visual debug tool (nodes, beams, collision triangles, center of gravity...). As long as nobody uses it, bdebugImpl.lua (large module) is not loaded: the functions marked "initialize" load bdebugImpl on their first call and then redirect to it. A modder mainly uses it to display text on nodes (setNodeDebugText) or to enable/disable the tool. The GE receives the state via guihooks BdebugUpdate and extensions.hook onBDebugUpdate (sent by bdebugImpl).
usage:
-- vehicle VM
bdebug.setNodeDebugText('myTest', 12, 'node 12')
bdebug.setEnabled(true)
-- cleanup
bdebug.clearTypeNodeDebugText('myTest')
notes: setPartsSelected, setNodeDebugText, clearNodeDebugText, clearTypeNodeDebugText and clearAllNodeDebugText can be called before bdebugImpl is initialized: the data is stored in a local state and then passed to bdebugImpl at its init. After init, these functions are replaced by those of bdebugImpl.

Before initialization, isEnabled() always returns false; receiveViewportSize is an empty function; nodeCollision, beamBroke, debugDraw, onPlayersChanged and reset are nop. They are replaced by redirections to bdebugImpl at init.
initState, state and stateNoReset are proxy tables: the first read or write of a field loads bdebugImpl and redirects to its tables.

toggleEnabled, nodetextModeChange, nodevisModeChange, nodedebugtextModeChange, skeletonModeChange, colTrisModeChange, cogChange and resetModes are reserved for input events; the code says not to use them from the UI.
bdebug.init does nothing (loading is lazy). bdebug.setPartsSelected is assigned twice in the file (harmless).
Persistence: onSerialize saves bdebugImpl.state if bdebugImpl has been initialized; onDeserialize reinitializes it right after a vehicle reload.

initState.desc: Proxy to bdebugImpl.initState (default state of the modes). Loads bdebugImpl on access.

state.desc: Proxy to bdebugImpl.state (current state). Loads bdebugImpl on access.

stateNoReset.desc: Proxy to bdebugImpl.stateNoReset (state not reset by resetModes). Loads bdebugImpl on access.

nodeCollision.desc: Node collision hook; nop until bdebugImpl is loaded, then redirects nodeCollision(p) to bdebugImpl.

beamBroke.desc: Beam break hook beamBroke(id, energy); nop before init, then redirection to bdebugImpl.

debugDraw.desc: Debug drawing debugDraw(focusPos) called by the main loop; nop before init, then redirection to bdebugImpl.

onPlayersChanged.desc: Player change hook; nop before init, then bdebugImpl.onPlayersChanged.

reset.desc: Vehicle reset; nop before init, then bdebugImpl.reset.

requestState.desc: Initializes bdebugImpl and requests that the current state be sent to the UI/GE (BdebugUpdate).

setState.desc: Initializes bdebugImpl then applies a state coming from the UI to it. Ignored if state.objectId is not the current object.

notSendBack.desc: true to not send the state back to the UI.

requestDrawnNodesGE.desc: Requests that at the next draw, the list of drawn nodes be sent to a GE Lua function, called as geFuncName(nodesDrawn, nodeScale).

geFuncName.desc: Name of the GE function (global path, e.g. 'myModule.receive').

requestDrawnBeamsGE.desc: Like requestDrawnNodesGE but for beams: calls geFuncName(beamsDrawn, beamScale) in the GE.

isEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the tool is visible. Always returns false before bdebugImpl is loaded, then bdebugImpl.isEnabled.

setEnabled.desc: Initializes bdebugImpl then shows/hides the vehicle's visual debug.

toggleEnabled.desc: Toggles the debug display. Reserved for the input system, do not call from the UI.

nodetextModeChange.desc: Switches to the next/previous node text mode (off, names, numbers, names+numbers, weights, materials, groups, forces, relativePositions, worldPositions, clusters). Called by input actions.

nodevisModeChange.desc: Changes the node visualization mode (off, simple, highlighted, weights, displacement, velocities, forces, density, clusters, mainCluster, nodeStability).

nodedebugtextModeChange.desc: Changes the displayed node debug text group (off then the groups created by setNodeDebugText).

skeletonModeChange.desc: Changes the beam (skeleton) visualization mode: off, simple, highlighted, type, type+broken, brokenOnly, supportOnly, stress, displacement, deformation, etc.

colTrisModeChange.desc: Changes the collision triangle mode (off, simple, type, withoutBroken, withBroken, brokenOnly, collideableOnly).

cogChange.desc: Changes the center of gravity display mode (cogModes, including 'off' and 'on').

resetModes.desc: Resets all modes to their default value (copy of initState) and displays the message vehicle.bdebug.clear.

setPartsSelected.desc: Defines the selected parts whose nodes/beams are highlighted. Usable before the init of bdebugImpl.

parts.desc: Part selection (partsSelected format used by bdebugImpl, inferred from code).

setNodeDebugText.desc: Adds a text on a node in a debug text group (the group is created if it does not exist). Several calls on the same node stack the texts. Usable before the init of bdebugImpl.

clearNodeDebugText.desc: Removes the texts of a node in a group.

clearTypeNodeDebugText.desc: Removes an entire text group (and shifts the indices of the following groups).

clearAllNodeDebugText.desc: Removes all node debug text groups.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before vehicle reload: returns {bdebugImplState = state} if bdebugImpl has already been initialized.

onDeserialize.desc: Restore hook after reload: if a bdebugImpl state was saved, initializes bdebugImpl with it.

receiveViewportSize.desc: Empty function until bdebugImpl is loaded; then replaced by bdebugImpl.receiveViewportSize(sizeX, sizeY).

init.desc: Empty function called at vehicle initialization; loading is lazy.
